📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred Big Ugly wears Alma's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Ugly falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Ugly!

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. Catalina: "Sanne and Elif blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 4 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Gilberto was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Davide taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Sanne has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Davide drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
